en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic stone fountain in strong contrast, shot from a low angle. In the foreground are curved basin steps with water, and a sculptural figure (likely a mythological creature or putto) from which water sprays upward. In the misty background stands a medieval or Gothic‑style civic building with crenellated roofline and a square tower topped by a small cross, suggesting a historic Italian piazza.
